purpose: Bounded source freshness, independent runtime checkpoints and optional ordered migration/current-state reconciliation.
use: An OOP update is available or due: check freshness, compatibility and authorization, then adopt independently per runtime.
semantic_conditions: Discovery or download never adopts rules automatically; peers keep independent checkpoints.
mandatory_preconditions: Observed remote identity, current adopted commit and authorization to adopt.
postconditions_verification: Owned checkpoint updated atomically after verification; knowledge realigned.
